title: Design workflow v2 recipe
description: A recipe is the routes.json `sequence` array widened from a hard-coded two-step list into a declarable N-step list. Every axis below is an existing routes.json axis; the recipe introduces no new routing vocabulary.

produces.description: Artifact type entering the state machine; must be a node in artifact-dag.json.

workflow.description: routes.json workflow axis. Fed to the existing resolver unchanged.

artifact.description: routes.json artifact axis. Omitted means the route must also omit it.

fidelity.description: routes.json fidelity axis. Omitted means the route must also omit it.

context.description: routes.json context axis. Omitted defaults to null (neutral).

review.description: Independent review triggered AFTER this step produces its artifact. See findings-p0.md R3: the produce-then-review handoff direction is not defined by skill-loading-protocol.md.

gate.description: Confirmation gate after this step. Omitted means no gate.

exploration.description: Marks a throwaway probe output. Exploration artifacts may not become a baseline and may not be cited as a PRD fact source.
